decisions.reason: As a newly launched resin injection unit closely aligned with our core application equipment business, it has shown no visible shortfall by 2019 and our organisational slack supports keeping it while market acceptance is still being learned.

This second resin injection unit fits our established engineering and customer base, and with no evidence yet that results fall below aspiration levels, management would continue it for another period.

The automatic airless spray gun extends a core product line and, absent clear signs of underperformance after only one year, a medium-sized experienced machinery firm would retain it while gathering more feedback.
The manual airless spray gun is highly consistent with our existing offerings and service capabilities, so without an observed performance shortfall we would keep it on the market.

The air-assisted airless spray gun leverages our established spraying technology and distributor network, and behavioral decision-making suggests patience when early results are still uncertain rather than immediate withdrawal.

The data logger supports our broader coating-equipment solution strategy and may strengthen service and customization, so with no clear evidence below aspiration we would continue it despite its newer digital character.
